help.title: Help
help.intro.title: What is Chalax?
help.intro.body: Chalax is a just-intonation (microtonal) overtone grid instrument based on LAMPLIGHT's Shasavistic music theory. It visualizes "dimension = prime overtone" as a two-dimensional lattice: each cell is a note, with the horizontal and vertical axes each corresponding to a dimension's prime overtone.
help.play.title: How to play
help.play.body: Click or drag cells to play; you can also use the keyboard (the middle asdf row is the root row). Hold a key for sustained sound; release to stop.
help.dimensions.title: Dimensions (prime overtones)
help.dimensions.body: 1D–5D correspond to primes 2, 3, 5, 7, 11. Choose one dimension for horizontal and one for vertical; a cell's pitch ratio = horizontalPrime^x × verticalPrime^y, octave-reduced.
help.diff.title: Difference
help.diff.body: The interval difference from each note to each dimension's overtone, shown as "comma ratio + cents". After enabling "Show difference", filter by threshold and dimension.
help.sound.title: Sound
help.sound.body: Six sound sources (sine wave and five samplers). The fundamental sets the base pitch; release adjusts the fade-out after a key is released.
help.grid.title: Grid & flash color
help.grid.body: Adjust the grid size. Flash color has three modes: Difference (nearest dimension color), Dimension direction (root white, others by last-step direction), Wavelength (map frequency as light wavelength to color). The saturation slider adjusts color intensity.
help.shape.title: Shape (chord)
help.shape.body: Record a "shape" — a set of notes relative to a root. After selecting a shape, clicking / keys play all its notes with that cell as the root.
help.shortcut.title: Shape shortcuts
help.shortcut.body: Use Shift+number row (!@#$%^&*()_+) to quickly switch shapes. Each shape can be assigned a custom key.
help.language.title: Language
help.language.body: The interface supports Chinese, English and Japanese.
